title: executive-daily-priorities-isabella-2026-03-06
body:
Morning scratchpad - quick brain dump for the day (Isabella)

Top objectives for the week (Mar 2 - Mar 8) - review before weekly exec sync:
- Finalize Dedicated pricing tiers + proposal doc (need legal input on indemnity wording) -> target to publish to sales by Wed 3/11.
- Private deployment pilot with Cardinal Health: confirm infra checklist and support SLAs, get sign-off on PoC timeline (SOW) by Fri.
- Shipping: rollout plan for 2.1 serving runtime improvements (latency targets + fallback policy) - ensure SRE runbook updated.
- Hiring: close director of product ops interview loop + offer letter prep.

Today (2026-03-06) - must-dos:
- 9:00 AM - Exec standup (15m) - topics: PoC status, sales blockers, any org escalations.
- 10:30 AM - Pricing review w/ finance (Priya) - bring draft pricing deck and model sensitivities (unit economics slide). Action: update slides with new quantization savings numbers (Ben from infra to confirm).
- 1:00 PM - Customer briefing prep: Cardinal Health PoC kickoff (internal dry-run 30m) - confirm RACI and success metrics (latency P99, throughput, data handling).
- 2:30 PM - 1:1 w/ CTO (Ravi) - discuss kernel selection roadmap and tradeoffs for A/B fallback.
- Block: 3:30–5:00 PM - buffer for follow-ups / email triage / send SOW draft to legal.

Follow-ups / notes to self:
- Legal: need clearer language on data residency + KMS responsibilities for Private customers. Ask Amy in legal to propose two variants (customer-managed KMS vs Redwood-managed KMS).
- Finance: check effect of Dedicated reserved capacity on ARR recognition - flagged by Marcus, follow up after pricing call.
- Sales: pushback expected on new Dedicated minimums - prepping counter-offer templates for enterprise AE playbook.
- Product: ensure console rollout shows per-route latency breakdown before canary; otherwise delay canary by 1 week.

Decisions to make this week:
- Do we enable auto-fallback to quantized model variants for free-tier? (pros: lower cost, cons: potential quality regressions). Draft poll for execs.
- Approve SOW template for Private deployment pilots (legal + delivery sign-off required).

Quick metrics / health check (top-line):
- Hosted API qps trend: +8% week-over-week, median latency stable 210ms, P99 +12ms (investigate).
- Dedicated capacity utilization: 72% avg; two pools over 85% last 48h -> ops alert to consider autoscale burst.
- Support: critical SEV escalations = 1 (customer X inference mismatch on tokenization) - assigned to Solutions Eng.

Delegation / playbook items:
- Priya: update pricing deck + model, capture finance sensitivity table.
- Avery: coordinate PoC infra checklist with Platform Eng and SRE; send to Cardinal by EOD Thu.
- Ravi: confirm kernel roadmap items for next two sprints and prioritize fallback implementation.
- Ben (infra): confirm quantization perf numbers + attach benchmark snippets to pricing deck.

Notes / loose thoughts (scratch):
- Need a short PR template for infra changes that impact performance (include perf regression checklist, test seeds, canary flags).
- Consider a small win: ship an "inference-cost-estimator" sample for sales to show predicted spend for common workloads. Could be a simple spreadsheet + API call example.

Links to review before meetings:
- Confluence: Q2 launch plan (CON-4821)
- Jira: JIRA-1198 (Dedicated pricing model)
- GH: roadmap PR (gh:repo/redwood-inference/roadmap#42)

End-of-day check (to fill):
- [ ] Pricing deck updated and shared
- [ ] SOW draft to legal sent
- [ ] PoC checklist sent to Cardinal
- [ ] Runbook note for canary updated

Random reminders / personal:
- Confirm lunch with Priya on Thu 3/12 (blocked)
- Book flight for SF customer visit (week of 3/23)

----
Notes to self style: keep short bullets, mark action owner next to item, unresolved items flagged with QUESTION.
